tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_alchemist_unstable_: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After %brew_time% seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after %brew_explosion% seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
While Alchemist is affected by Chemical Rage, cooldown is reduced by %chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%.
A silver lining to the failure of turning a mountain into gold, this volatile solution has destructive potential.

A timer above Alchemist's head will indicate the remaining brew time. This timer is visible to enemies.
You can deny yourself with this skill.
Unstable Concoction cannot be disjointed and once thrown Unstable Concoction stops brewing.
Unstable Concoction explosion damages heroes and creeps.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_alchemist_bio:
The sacred science of Chymistry was a Darkbrew family tradition, but no Darkbrew had ever shown the kind of creativity, ambition, and recklessness of young Razzil. However, when adulthood came calling he pushed aside the family trade to try his hand at manufacturing gold through Alchemy.

In an act of audacity befitting his reputation, Razzil announced he would transmute an entire mountain into gold. Following two decades of research and spending and preparation, he failed spectacularly, quickly finding himself imprisoned for the widespread destruction his experiment wrought. Yet Razzil was never one to take a setback lightly, and sought escape to continue his research.

When his new cellmate turned out to be a fierce ogre, he found just the opportunity he needed. After convincing the ogre not to eat him, Razzil set about carefully concocting a tincture for it to drink, made from the moulds and mosses growing in the prison stone work. In a week's time, it seemed ready. When the ogre drank the potion, it flew into an unstoppable berserker rage, destroying the cell bars and exploding through walls and guards alike.

They soon found themselves lost somewhere in the forest surrounding the city with a trail of wreckage in their wake and no signs of pursuit. In the tonic's afterglow, the ogre seemed serene, happy, and even eager. Resolving to work together, the pair set off to collect the materials needed to attempt Razzil's Alchemic transmutation once more.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_alchemist_hype: Synthesizing extra resources from each and every kill, Alchemist has no trouble gathering the tools needed to destroy his foes. Ambushing enemies with corrosive acid and a host of unstable chemicals, he battles to ensure his greedy escapades can remain uninterrupted.

* This {{M|innate}} ability is in the {{Spellslot|5|6}}.

* Greevil's Greed is an {{M|on-death effect}}.
** Grants a stack per last hit of Alchemist on units with a {{M|death}} {{M|gold}} bounty.
** A second bounty number appears next to the last hit bounty, only visible to Alchemist, indicating the extra gold granted.
** Does not grant stacks from the following units:
*** {{M|Buildings}}
*** {{M|Illusions}} and the {{M|Tempest Double}}.
*** {{M|Deny|text=Denies}} and last hits of Alchemist's {{M|summons}}.
*** Units with {{M|Reincarnation}} sources, except for {{U|Wraith King Skeleton|text=Wraith King Skeletons}}.

* {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}}
** All stacks work independently with its own {{#var:Greevil's Greed value5}}-second duration.
*** The buff value indicates the extra {{M|gold}} Alchemist gains on the next last hit.
** {{cf|talnotes}} Grants flat {{M|bonus attack damage}}.

* {{Symbol|Gold}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** The bonus [[Gold]] granted has the following properties:
** [[Unreliable gold]] bonus from last hits.
** [[Reliable gold]] bonus from all activated {{M|Bounty Rune|text=Bounty Runes}} of Alchemist's team.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Alchemist's hero model has the following hidden {{M|innate}} abilities.

They both may only perform or utilize the ability's functions upon a successful channeling, excluding passive innate abilities.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
Melts down an Aghanim's Scepter in his inventory, synthesizing a buff that grants an allied hero all of its upgrades.

Grants self bonus attack damage.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Grants all of the item's stats to the unit-targeted allied hero as a permanent status buff.

buff2text
fields.value: Aghanim's Granted: Gaining x bonus attack damage from Aghanim scepters granted to allies.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
{{Innatecard}}

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Interrupts Alchemist's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.
** {{M|Aghanim's Scepter}} of Alchemist's has the following properties:
*** The item is an active ability.
**** {{M|Doubletap}} self-casts the ability.
** Grants the following bonuses per stack upon cast:
*** Flat {{M|bonus attack damage}}.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|item_ultimate_scepter_consumed_alchemist}}
** Neither can cast nor reapply the buff on an allied hero who already has the buff.
** Upon cast, the {{M|Aghanim's Scepter}} is consumed while the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted allied hero is granted all of the item's properties as a buff. This includes the following:
*** The item's stats.
*** The item's [[Gold#Net Worth|net worth]] is now transferred from Alchemist to the affected target.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
** For affected allied heroes who already have {{M|Aghanim's Scepter}} either in their {{M|inventory}} or {{M|backpack}}:
*** Refunds as {{ValueColor||{{Show|I|Aghanim's Scepter|item cost}}|gold|x}} {{M|unreliable gold}}.
*** Both types of {{M|Aghanim's Blessing}} refunds {{Gold|{{Show|I|Aghanim's Blessing|item cost}}}} unreliable gold regardless of how the affected ally acquires the {{M|Aghanim's Blessing|x}} buff.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: Using traditional [[Alchemy]] from the [[Darkbrew family]], Razzil concocts an acid that dissolves even the toughest metals.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Deals damage per second and applies an armor reduction within the radius.

fields.name: interacts
debuff1text
fields.value: Taking periodic damage, armor reduced by x. Armor increased by x.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|alchemist_acid_spray}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Aura}}
** [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-2.png|84px]]
*** Creates an [[aura]] at the {{Symbol|Target|Area}} area-targeted location upon cast.
*** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{calc|v1+{{#var:Acid Spray cast range}}|v1={{#var:Acid Spray value1}}}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
** Both the {{M|bonus armor}} reduction and the damage per second components are independent of each other.
*** For units already affected by the debuff, the armor value of the current instance does not update upon leveling up the ability.
*** However, the armor value of the current instance updates if the debuff was applied after leveling up the ability.
** All ability components do not affect the following units:
*** {{M|Couriers}}

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# Deals {{M|physical}} {{M|spell damage}} to affected enemy units in 1-second intervals within the radius, starting immediately upon debuff application, over {{#expr:{{#var:Acid Spray value5}}+1}} instances.
*#* The damage per second value of the current instance does not update with the ability level.
*#* {{Symbol|Target|Area-Inter}}
*#** Multiple overlapping Acid Spray damage radius stack.
*# Applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|alchemist_[[Alchemist#Corrosive Weaponry|corrosive_weaponry]]_debuff}} of its corresponding level in 1-second intervals within the radius, starting 1 second upon the {{M|spell damage}} application.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: A silver lining to the failure of turning a mountain into [[gold]], this volatile solution has destructive potential.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Brews up an unstable concoction that the Alchemist can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage within the radius around the explosion.

The longer the brew, the more the damage and the longer the stun. While brewing, Alchemist moves faster.

The brew reaches its max power after a period of time, and explodes himself if not thrown before the max brew time.

fields.value:
* {{Symbol|a|sub}}
** Replaces {{A|Alchemist|Unstable Concoction}} until this [[sub-ability]] is used or the Unstable Concoction self-explodes.
** Upon the sub-ability cast, Unstable Concoction stops brewing, then Alchemist launches a {{M|projectile}}.

* [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-1.png|84px]]
** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Unstable Concoction Throw cast range}}+{{#var:Unstable Concoction Throw value1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t1l}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Unstable Concoction Throw cast range}}+{{#var:Unstable Concoction Throw value1 tal}}}}|10tal}})-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].

* {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}}
** Can only be {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Target|Area}} unit and area-targeted on enemy heroes.
*** Considers {{M|clones}} and {{M|illusions}} as heroes, {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
** {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}}
*** Applies all the ability effects to valid enemy units within the radius, including when the projectile impacts on the following heroes:
**** {{M|Invulnerable}} heroes.
**** {{M|Hidden}} heroes.
*** Although the ability cannot target creeps, the ability effects fully affect enemy creeps within the radius upon projectile impact.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_alchemist
data.bio_loc:
The sacred science of Chymistry was a Darkbrew family tradition, but no Darkbrew had ever shown the kind of creativity, ambition, and recklessness of young Razzil. However, when adulthood came calling he pushed aside the family trade to try his hand at manufacturing gold through Alchemy.

In an act of audacity befitting his reputation, Razzil announced he would transmute an entire mountain into gold. Following two decades of research and spending and preparation, he failed spectacularly, quickly finding himself imprisoned for the widespread destruction his experiment wrought. Yet Razzil was never one to take a setback lightly, and sought escape to continue his research.

When his new cellmate turned out to be a fierce ogre, he found just the opportunity he needed. After convincing the ogre not to eat him, Razzil set about carefully concocting a tincture for it to drink, made from the moulds and mosses growing in the prison stone work. In a week's time, it seemed ready. When the ogre drank the potion, it flew into an unstoppable berserker rage, destroying the cell bars and exploding through walls and guards alike.

They soon found themselves lost somewhere in the forest surrounding the city with a trail of wreckage in their wake and no signs of pursuit. In the tonic's afterglow, the ogre seemed serene, happy, and even eager. Resolving to work together, the pair set off to collect the materials needed to attempt Razzil's Alchemic transmutation once more.
data.hype_loc: Synthesizing extra resources from each and every kill, Alchemist has no trouble gathering the tools needed to destroy his foes. Ambushing enemies with corrosive acid and a host of unstable chemicals, he battles to ensure his greedy escapades can remain uninterrupted.
data.npe_desc_loc: Earns extra gold from unit kills and bounty runes

abilities.name: alchemist_acid_spray
abilities.desc_loc: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.
abilities.lore_loc: Using traditional Alchemy from the Darkbrew family, Razzil concocts an acid that dissolves even the toughest metals.

abilities.name: alchemist_unstable_concoction
abilities.desc_loc: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After %brew_time% seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after %brew_explosion% seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
abilities.lore_loc: A silver lining to the failure of turning a mountain into gold, this volatile solution has destructive potential.
notes_loc: While brewing, this ability is replaced by Unstable Concoction Throw.  Alchemist can move and act normally while brewing.
A timer above Alchemist's head will indicate the remaining brew time. This timer is visible to enemies.
You can deny yourself with this skill.
Unstable Concoction cannot be disjointed and once thrown Unstable Concoction stops brewing.
Unstable Concoction explosion damages heroes and creeps.
facets_loc: While Alchemist is affected by Chemical Rage, cooldown is reduced by %chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%.

abilities.name: alchemist_corrosive_weaponry
abilities.desc_loc:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply %stacks_per_attack% stacks. Unstable Concoction applies %one_tooltip% stack per second of brew time.
abilities.lore_loc: A powerful solvent that turned out to work all too well.

abilities.desc_loc:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: After Razzil's great grandfather tested an early version of this potion on himself, a surviving family member immediately saw the profit potential.
facets_loc: While Alchemist is affected by Chemical Rage, cooldown is reduced by %chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%.

abilities.name: alchemist_goblins_greed
abilities.desc_loc: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next %duration% seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
abilities.lore_loc: While it is not a mountain, Razzil has mastered the conversion of smaller compounds to line his pockets.
abilities.scepter_loc: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and %bonus_gold_per_scepter% additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.
facets_loc: Alchemist gains %gpm_increase_per_stack% GPM for each Aghanim's Scepter he has granted to allies.

abilities.name: alchemist_chemical_rage
abilities.desc_loc:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: The brew Razzil gave to the Ogre during their prison bust has become a useful potion in the midst of combat.
notes_loc: Has a %transformation_time% second transformation time, which can be used to dodge projectiles and stuns.
